WITH store AS (
  SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE store_name = 'PowerTool shop by Praterstern' AND city = 'Vienna' LIMIT 1
),
p0 AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Raaco' AND series = 'Raaco Professional CarryLite 3CS-7A9 Shelving and Cabinet' AND model = 'Shelving and Cabinet' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'storage type' AND property_value_text = 'stacking box') LIMIT 1
),
p1 AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Bahco' AND series = 'Bahco Comfort Grip BE 1ZR-PGS Pliers and Wrenches' AND model = 'Pliers and Wrenches' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'tool type' AND property_value_text = 'side cutter') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '125 mm') LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Metabo' AND series = 'Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver' AND model = 'Cordless Drill Driver' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'voltage' AND property_value_text = '18 V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'battery platform' AND property_value_text = '18v-system') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'kit contents' AND property_value_text = 'case') LIMIT 1
),
p3 AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Bahco' AND series = 'Bahco Comfort Grip BE 1ZR-PGS Pliers and Wrenches' AND model = 'Pliers and Wrenches' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'tool type' AND property_value_text = 'side cutter') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '300 mm') LIMIT 1
),
p4 AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Geberit' AND series = 'Geberit Mapress Silent IC5-GU6 Valve and Connector' AND model = 'Valve and Connector' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'connector type' AND property_value_text = 'ball valve') LIMIT 1
),
p5 AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Schneider Electric' AND series = 'Schneider Electric Heavy Duty Merten 214-ZHY Extension Cable' AND model = 'Extension Cable' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'color family' AND property_value_text = 'White') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '3 m') LIMIT 1
),
zero_flags AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p0.product_sku AND si.available_today_quantity = 0) AS z0,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p1.product_sku AND si.available_today_quantity = 0) AS z1,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p2.product_sku AND si.available_today_quantity = 0) AS z2,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p3.product_sku AND si.available_today_quantity = 0) AS z3,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p4.product_sku AND si.available_today_quantity = 0) AS z4,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) AND si.product_sku = p5.product_sku AND si.available_today_quantity = 0) AS z5
)
SELECT
  (SELECT record_path FROM store) AS store_record_path,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM p0) AS p0_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM p0) AS p0_path,
  (SELECT z0 FROM zero_flags) AS p0_zero,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM p1) AS p1_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM p1) AS p1_path,
  (SELECT z1 FROM zero_flags) AS p1_zero,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM p2) AS p2_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM p2) AS p2_path,
  (SELECT z2 FROM zero_flags) AS p2_zero,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM p3) AS p3_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM p3) AS p3_path,
  (SELECT z3 FROM zero_flags) AS p3_zero,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM p4) AS p4_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM p4) AS p4_path,
  (SELECT z4 FROM zero_flags) AS p4_zero,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM p5) AS p5_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM p5) AS p5_path,
  (SELECT z5 FROM zero_flags) AS p5_zero,
  (SELECT (z0+z1+z2+z3+z4+z5) FROM zero_flags) AS count_zero;
